ipv4:
*filter
:FORWARD ACCEPT [0:0]
:PVEFW-FORWARD - [0:0]
:PVEFW-FWBR-IN - [0:0]
:PVEFW-FWBR-OUT - [0:0]
:PVEFW-SET-ACCEPT-MARK - [0:0]
:veth800080i0-IN - [0:0]
:veth800080i0-OUT - [0:0]
-A FORWARD -j PVEFW-FORWARD
-A PVEFW-FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
-A PVEFW-FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A PVEFW-FORWARD -m physdev --physdev-is-bridged --physdev-in fwln+ -j PVEFW-FWBR-IN
-A PVEFW-FORWARD -m physdev --physdev-is-bridged --physdev-out fwln+ -j PVEFW-FWBR-OUT
-A PVEFW-FWBR-IN -m physdev --physdev-is-bridged --physdev-out veth800080i0 -j veth800080i0-IN
-A PVEFW-FWBR-OUT -m physdev --physdev-is-bridged --physdev-in veth800080i0 -j veth800080i0-OUT
-A PVEFW-SET-ACCEPT-MARK -j MARK --set-xmark 0x80000000/0x80000000
-A veth800080i0-IN -j CONNMARK --set-xmark 0xc3550/0xffffffff
-A veth800080i0-IN -s 192.0.2.25/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
-A veth800080i0-IN -j DROP
-A veth800080i0-IN -j PVEFW-Drop
-A veth800080i0-IN -j DROP
-A veth800080i0-OUT -j CONNMARK --set-xmark 0xc3550/0xffffffff
-A veth800080i0-OUT -m mac ! --mac-source 02:00:5e:70:00:80 -j DROP
-A veth800080i0-OUT -m set ! --match-set PVEFW-800080-ipfilter-net0-v4 src -j DROP
-A veth800080i0-OUT -j MARK --set-xmark 0x0/0x80000000
-A veth800080i0-OUT -d 192.0.2.123/32 -p udp -m udp --dport 123 -g PVEFW-SET-ACCEPT-MARK
-A veth800080i0-OUT -j DROP
-A veth800080i0-OUT -j PVEFW-Drop
-A veth800080i0-OUT -j DROP
